description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Double, which represents an XML-RPC double (floating-point) value. It extends a scalar value class and provides methods to set and retrieve the double value, formatting the value according to the PHP configuration.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Double
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC double (floating point) value, with methods to set the value during construction and retrieve it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Double object, initializing with a float value and formatting it according to the PHP precision setting.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored XML-RPC double value as a PHP float.
